1  Paper details

Set "first question number" to 4 when this paper is a later section of a bigger exam, the way your 2025 and 2026 Grade 9 papers were numbered.

2  Where should the content come from?

From uploaded examples Upload last year's paper. Claude copies the layout and mark pattern, then writes all-new content.
From my instructions No uploads. Just name the topics, e.g. "Subsidiary journals, Debtors ledger, General Ledger".
Examples + my instructions Follow the uploaded layout, but cover the topics you specify.
Follow a framework Upload a document that spells out exactly what each question must contain.
Drop past papers, answer sheets, memos or a framework here — or click to browse

Tap FRAMEWORK on a file to mark it as binding instructions rather than a style example.
